summary: grill stage burns its 12-turn cap exploring large/self-referential repos instead of asking questions (error_max_turns, $0.63 spent, no questions produced)
repro_command: node harness/dist/cli.js run '<task naming files in a large repo without anchors>' --repo C:/Users/PC/agentic-workflow
prevention_layer: grill brief should forbid deep exploration (ask, don't read) or the engine should pass a smaller exploration allowance; workaround proven: enrich pipeline.json task with exact file anchors, then resume
regression_test: harness/tests/briefs.test.ts: 'directs the agent to ask instead of exploring the repo' (old Skim-the-repository invitation must be gone), 'keeps the grill turn cap small' (cap <= 6)
